newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - LS dead, HS under pressure.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - LS dead, HS under pressure.

text.p: The low sulphur straight run market was judged to be very quiet on Tuesday.
There was market talk of a Portuguese handysize sell tender, but problems at Leixoes port meant dates were difficult to make and the tender was not official.
Prices were pegged around $144 fob NWE.

Russian high sulphur straight run fuel was still available "There's about three E-4's and two M-100 (for Dec loading," said one trader. E-E's were seen around the flat formula while M-100 might go for two means +$1. -- +44 171 542 8980
